description: This file defines a Prometheus collector for Go runtime metrics, including rules for selecting specific metric groups and functions to enable or disable certain metrics.

classes.name: GoRuntimeMetricsRule
classes.description: Represents a rule for enabling or configuring a group of runtime/metrics based on a regex matcher.

methods.name: WithGoCollectorMemStatsMetricsDisabled
methods.description: Returns a function that disables metrics gathered from runtime.MemStats.

methods.name: WithGoCollectorRuntimeMetrics
methods.description: Enables and configures specific groups of runtime/metrics based on provided rules.

methods.name: WithoutGoCollectorRuntimeMetrics
methods.description: Disables specific groups of runtime/metrics based on provided regex matchers.

methods.name: WithGoCollections
methods.description: Enables or disables collections of Go runtime metrics based on flags (deprecated).

methods.name: NewGoCollector
methods.description: Creates a new Prometheus collector for Go runtime metrics.
